rows.grounds: instrumental of bhāvanā, indicating the means
temporal or sequential particle following prior purification
gerundive expressing obligation or fitness for worship
compound denoting the practitioner's chosen deity

items.question: By what means is one's own deity to be worshipped after material purification?
premises: Material purification has already been established as a prior step.
Contemplation functions as an effective means of worship.
One's own deity is the designated object of this worship.
items.inference: After material purification, worship is properly performed through contemplation of one's own deity.
items.plain_english: Then, through contemplation, one's own deity is to be worshipped.
